think: 32-year-old woman with nasopharyngeal mass and cervical lymphadenopathy. Biopsy showed caseating granulomas with AFB. Sputum smear was also positive for AFB. Diagnosis: Nasopharyngeal tuberculosis (extrapulmonary) secondary to pulmonary tuberculosis.

42-year-old female with bilateral matted inguinal lymphadenopathy and discharging sinus. FNAC showed Langhans giant cells and epithelioid cells, diagnostic of tuberculous lymphadenitis (extrapulmonary TB).
42-year-old female with fever, cervical lymphadenopathy, pleural effusion, and hypercalcemia. Lymph node biopsy was GeneXpert positive for MTB. Diagnosed explicitly with extrapulmonary tuberculosis.

9-year-old boy with T12/L1 destruction and paravertebral abscess (Pott's disease). Biopsy showed necrotizing granulomas with Langhans cells and MGIT culture confirmed rifampin-monoresistant M. tuberculosis (MDR extrapulmonary TB).
41-year-old male with pulmonary TB who presented with mechanical bowel obstruction. Exploratory laparotomy and histopathology confirmed abdominal/peritoneal tuberculosis with caseating granulomas.
37-year-old male with sternoclavicular joint destruction and subcutaneous abscess. Pus culture grew M. tuberculosis and biopsy showed caseous necrosis, establishing tuberculous arthritis.
29-year-old woman with right sacroiliac joint destruction and extensive thigh cold abscesses. AFB culture confirmed M. tuberculosis complex infection (extrapulmonary MTB).
77-year-old male with left hip effusion and iliopsoas involvement. Joint clearance biopsy demonstrated caseous granulomatous inflammation and mNGS from synovial fluid detected M. tuberculosis.
71-year-old man with recurrent anal fistula/abscess whose biopsy revealed anal mucinous adenocarcinoma coexisting with caseous epithelioid granulomas of anal tuberculosis.
51-year-old male with disseminated tuberculosis involving thoracic spine (Pott's disease), liver, prostate, mediastinum, and lungs, verified by mNGS and histology.
24-year-old male presenting with cold chest wall masses and 3rd rib destruction. Aspirate PCR and culture grew M. tuberculosis complex, confirming chest wall tuberculosis.

20-year-old female with fever of unknown origin; PET-CT revealed FDG uptake in large vessel walls, mediastinal/abdominal lymph nodes, pericardium, pleural effusion, and ascites, diagnostic of disseminated extrapulmonary TB with aorto-arteritis.
40-year-old female with PET-CT showing FDG uptake in enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, ascending/arch aorta walls, and pericardium, establishing extrapulmonary TB with aortoarteritis.

19-year-old female with preauricular swelling and mandibular condyle osteolysis. Sequestrectomy histology showed caseation granulomas with Langhans cells and PCR was positive for TB bacilli (tuberculous osteomyelitis).
45-year-old male with septic arthritis of the hip. GeneXpert and long-term culture identified Mycobacterium microti (member of M. tuberculosis complex), establishing extrapulmonary tuberculosis.
34-year-old woman with a large renal mass and lymphadenopathy. Nephrectomy histopathology demonstrated acid-fast bacilli and granulomas confirming genitourinary tuberculosis.
26-year-old female presenting with acute appendicular peritonitis. Histopathology of resected appendix revealed gigantocellular epithelioid granulomas with caseous necrosis (tubercular appendicitis).

25-year-old male with an indurated facial plaque and strongly positive Mantoux test. Histopathology showed epithelioid granulomas with Langhans giant cells consistent with lupus vulgaris (cutaneous TB).
24-year-old lactating female with maxillary gingival soft tissue overgrowth. Histopathology revealed Langhans giant cells and epithelioid cells, with complete resolution on ATT (oral/gingival TB).
68-year-old man with constrictive pericarditis and pericardial effusion. Resected pericardium tested positive for M. tuberculosis, confirming tuberculous pericarditis.
49-year-old man with small bowel obstruction secondary to intestinal strictures and lymphadenopathy. Histopathology confirmed caseating granulomas with ZN-positive acid-fast bacilli (intestinal TB).
23-year-old male with scrotal swelling and discharging sinus. GeneXpert Ultra on sinus swab detected M. tuberculosis complex, confirming tuberculous epididymo-orchitis.
66-year-old male with a large left renal cystic lesion. Aspirated fluid culture isolated M. tuberculosis (renal tuberculosis).
62-year-old male with miliary pulmonary TB, T11/T12 spinal abscess (Pott's disease), and renal involvement. Sputum and urine grew AFB, confirming disseminated/extrapulmonary TB.
43-year-old male with miliary pulmonary pattern, D9/D10 tuberculous spondylodiscitis, and genitourinary TB (BAL and urine isolated M. tuberculosis complex).

50-year-old male with chronic cholecystitis and gallbladder perforation. Post-cholecystectomy histopathology demonstrated caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, confirming gallbladder tuberculosis.

51-year-old immunosuppressed female with ascites and omental caking. Axillary lymph node biopsy confirmed necrotizing granulomas with rare AFB, and nodal/omental cultures grew M. tuberculosis (peritoneal and nodal TB).
